supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Read stop main extreme then normalize opposite Order boundary. Exact bullish after when bottom<=stop Low, otherwise after when top>=stop High; equality after. Legacy before returns before S16. Nonnull nested match preserves after, no candidate timing query.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Default null stop event to main open; S30 candidate then S31 returned time, then read Order First open. Strict earlier -> before, equal/later -> after. S31 fallback not observed exact event.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Default null stop time only; integer First; S13 full-main candidate computed before lower remainder even if discarded later. Reversed range propagates. Lower query from supplied event, not clamped to stop main open, to stop main end exclusive. Empty returns initial candidate.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Seed first lower row, strict directional improvement keeps first tie. Later S13 only First>stop index, compare strictly; tie or absent keeps stop main positional index/time and selected lower price. Lower source row reference not output.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Read source main open; query max(open,not_before) through open+TF. First equal normalized price -> lower event. Otherwise max(open,not_before) even beyond nominal end. Public fallback parameter is lower gate, not independently selected replacement time.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Explicit formation_time nonnull returns unchanged before accessing required source fields. Otherwise int source index/main open, string kind !=reset chooses any nonreset kind. Integer ordinal valid 1..count uses S04 default intrabar, fallback possible; invalid ordinal uses source open.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Reset broken_level optional, null returns source. Lower query whole source main. Per row select Low/High, normalize value, then normalize broken_level in selected strict comparison; empty avoids broken-level conversion. First hit exact timestamp, no hit source open; no main OHLC proof.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: Invalid ordinal rejects before lookup. First valid Reset Blue map from S01 may include internal, not necessarily earliest formation. Nonnull formation<=event, no same-main or behavior_start bound.

supplemental_items.discovery_reason: Source-first ordered evaluation, provenance, implicit dependency, state or fallback beyond original category labels.
supplemental_items.interpretation: S35 upper_bound sorted trend confirmation times at behavior_start, bounds then <=event, includes native fallback times. S36 normalizes directional price then strict policy cross.

findings.description: Preserve fallback provenance in pre/post timing.
findings.resolution: return before iff S31 returned candidate time<main Order First timestamp, else after (equality after). S31 may return a fallback, not proof of an observed price event.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.

findings.description: Explicit unclamped lower remainder start and fallback.
findings.resolution: Query lower remainder [supplied or fallback A-stop time,stop main end), with no extra clamp to stop main open; empty returns the already-computed full-main candidate.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.

findings.description: Preserve per-row conversion order and explicit/fallback time provenance.
findings.resolution: Reset: if broken_level null return source; otherwise scan [source,source+timeframe), normalize each selected lower price then normalize broken_level inside that row's selected strict comparison. Empty range never normalizes broken_level. Return first strict crossing timestamp or source fallback. Explicit formation and non-Reset S04 returns are not independent proof of observed crossing.
findings.recheck: W2 caller and W3 forensic review pending.
